question: Explain why no work is done in moving a charge from one point to another on an equipotential surface. Give reason.

options.A: Work done is $qV$ because the potential value is non-zero
options.B: Work done is zero because $W=q\Delta V$ and $\Delta V=0$ on an equipotential surface
options.C: Work done is equal to the electric field multiplied by the path length
options.D: Work done is non-zero because an electric field may exist normal to the surface
